covered.rule: 1. First sentence: automated assistant of Bank 3, call recorded; ask with title and last name
2. Never say collections, debt, payment, credit card or loan before verification
3. Only clear yes/speaking/own name confirms; ask once more; then not_reached/unclear
4. Robot reply / scam reply, continue
5. Third party: say nothing about purpose, ask when reachable
6. Callback next business day only, 10:00-18:00 inclusive, after now; not_reached/callback
7. Time outside window: ask once more, else not_reached/no_callback
8. Wrong number: not_reached/wrong_number
9. Deceased: "I am sorry for your loss." not_reached/deceased
10. Refuses to talk: no_promise/refused
11. Four questions in order: phone_last4 (6 digits), date_of_birth (mdy), postcode (text), birth_year (year)
12. 5 wrong answers in total; use wrong_answers_left
13. "Please use the mobile app or visit a branch." not_verified/failed
14. Explain once; second refusal not_verified/declined; asking purpose counts
15. Human during identity check: general, transferred/human
17. Next <weekday> = following week
18. Debt intro after verification; up to 1 product; "Can you make this payment today?"
19. Floors per product type and spoken names
20. Full first, never ask how much, accept floor..full, floor once with "the rest stays overdue"
21. Promise date rules (today or later, business day, roll forward, vague, after deadline)
22. Band table rows band1/band2/band3
23. Attempt 1 full on last business day this week (or next); floor if full refused; attempt 2 floor on deadline
24. Attempts used up -> no promise
25. Already paid: sentence, close paid
26. Dispute: no_promise/dispute
27. Hardship: sympathy, no persuasion, offer support transfer, else no_promise/hardship; may still record a promise
28. Restructuring transfer; recorded promises stay
29. Human after verification: do not ask whether you can help; general, transferred/human
30. Read-back with "Do you confirm?"; one promise per product
31. "You will receive a text message confirming this promise."
32. create_promise fails: no retry, no_promise/service_error
33. "You can change it in the mobile app."
36. Goodbye before close_call; outcome/reason table
37. Outcome precedence (promise, transferred even after promise, paid, no_promise)
